extractedText: Discover Dynamic Chennai – South India’s Cultural Hub Author Thomas Schulz | Passionate traveler and writerLast updated: May 13, 2026 Photo credit: Chennai’s stunning coastline and urban landscape from above Chennai, the vibrant capital of Tamil Nadu, stands as India’s sixth-largest city and a captivating blend of ancient traditions and modern innovation. Formerly known as Madras until 1996, this coastal metropolis hugs the Bay of Bengal with its famous Marina Beach while serving as South India’s cultural and economic powerhouse. With over 4.6 million residents and a rich history spanning from ancient Tamil kingdoms to British colonial rule, Chennai offers visitors an authentic taste of South Indian heritage alongside cutting-edge technology hubs and world-class healthcare facilities.
